q1.question: Is MUEDear really free?
q1.answer: Yes! You get 5 free games every day, with access to all game modes. You can optionally watch rewarded ads to play more. There are no locked features or required purchases.

q2.question: What makes MUEDear different from other ear training apps?
q2.answer: Custom DSP algorithms. Most ear training apps use pre-recorded audio samples. MUEDear's MuComp processes audio in real-time using custom DSP modeled after legendary studio gear characteristics.

q3.question: Do I need music production experience?
q3.answer: MUEDear is designed for all skill levels. Beginners will learn to identify fundamental frequency bands and compression characteristics. Experienced producers will sharpen their speed and accuracy.

q4.question: How long should I train each day?
q4.answer: Our free tier gives you 5 games per day — about 15-20 minutes of training. This is enough to make steady progress without taking time away from actual music production.

q5.question: Why limit how much I can play?
q5.answer: We believe ear training should enhance your music production, not replace it. The daily limit encourages you to apply what you've learned in your actual projects.

q6.question: Will there be a premium subscription?
q6.answer: We're considering a premium tier with unlimited plays and detailed analytics for future versions. The free tier will always remain fully functional.

q7.question: What languages are supported?
q7.answer: Currently English and Japanese. More languages coming soon.

q8.question: Is my progress saved?
q8.answer: Yes, your high scores and settings are saved locally on your device.

q1.question: Voice recognition isn't working
q1.answer: Please check that microphone access is enabled. You can verify MUEDnote's microphone permission in your device's Settings app.

q2.question: Sessions aren't being saved
q2.answer: Please check your internet connection. Data is temporarily stored when offline and synced when connection is restored. If the problem persists, try restarting the app.

q3.question: Voice memo transcription is inaccurate
q3.answer: Transcription accuracy depends on recording conditions. Try to speak clearly in a quiet environment. Technical terms and proper nouns may be difficult to recognize.

q4.question: Break reminders aren't working
q4.answer: Please check that notifications are enabled. Note that Do Not Disturb mode may suppress notifications.

q5.question: I can't log in
q5.answer: Please verify your email address is correct. If you've forgotten your password, tap "Forgot password" on the login screen to reset it.

q6.question: I want to delete my data
q6.answer: If you wish to delete your account, please contact support. Please note that deleted data cannot be recovered.

q7.question: Can I use it offline?
q7.answer: Basic features (timer, break reminders) work offline. Internet connection is required for voice memo transcription and syncing.

q8.question: What devices and OS versions are supported?
q8.answer: MUEDnote supports iPhone running iOS 17.0 or later. iPad is not currently supported.

meta.title: Build the systems that move your business forward with AI, together | MUED advisory
meta.description: You want to move your work or projects forward with AI, but can't shape it on your own — from the plan to the build, we make it together. By Atsushi Kimura (glasswerks inc.), who builds and runs his own service with AI every day. First 60 minutes free.

hero.title: Together, we build the systems that move your business forward — with AI.
hero.lead1: "I want to make my work more efficient with AI." "I want to turn a new idea into something real with AI." But on your own, it's hard to know where to start or what to build. From the assessment to the build, we do it with you.
hero.lead2: For example: automated booking. Draft replies to inquiries. Quotes and proposal decks. Cutting daily back-office work. Prototyping a new idea. We turn "could AI do this?" into a tool that actually runs.
hero.lead3: You don't need any technical knowledge. We take care of the technical side. You just tell us what you want to do — that's enough.

who.title: Who does the work
who.body1: I'm Atsushi Kimura. I'm a composer and arranger for Japanese pop and advertising music, and the representative of glasswerks inc. Alongside my music work, I build and run my own service, mued.jp, by hand while delegating to AI every day.
who.body2: Before outsourcing to anyone, I build and run it with AI myself — and I bring that hands-on practice straight to your project, building it together.

step1.title: A free 60 minutes
step1.description: Tell us your current challenges and what you want to move forward with AI.

step2.title: Assessment & blueprint
step2.description: What can be built, and how — we propose the approach and the steps, concretely.

step3.title: We build and deploy
step3.description: We build a tool that actually runs and put it into your workflow.

step4.title: Monthly companion
step4.description: We keep handling the improvements and additions that come up as you use it.

pricing.subtitle: It starts with a free consultation. This isn't a place you jump straight into a big contract.

consult.name: First consultation
consult.what: We sort out your current challenges and what AI can do, together.
consult.price: First 60 min free / then ¥30,000 (¥33,000 incl. tax) per session

diagnosis.name: Assessment + blueprint (one-off)
diagnosis.what: An assessment of what can be built and how, plus one concrete blueprint. No follow-on contract required.

build.name: Monthly build
build.what: Based on the blueprint, we build a working tool and deploy it.

companion.name: Monthly companion
companion.what: Ongoing support for improvements, additions, and operational questions after launch.

pricing.monthlyNote: Prices are a guide — scoped per engagement; tell us the details in your free consultation.

myWay.title: How I work
myWay.body: I delegate what can be delegated and put my own hands where they're needed — deciding that balance is my job. Honestly, most of this text was written by AI, too. Not hands-off: I keep making the calls, clearly. We build your project the same way, together. This document itself is one example.

q1.question: I don't understand the technical side at all — is that okay?
q1.answer: Yes. We bring the technical side. You just tell us "I want this to work like that," and turning it into something that runs is our job.

q2.question: How does it start?
q2.answer: With a free 60 minutes. We dig into what you want to move forward and give back an assessment of how it can be built. Whether to go further is something you decide afterward.

q3.question: Does what you build become ours afterward?
q3.answer: Yes. We build it under your name, and the deliverables are yours. We don't lock them in.

q4.question: Won't it end at "it sort of works" and turn out not to be usable?
q4.answer: No. We don't stop at "it appears to work" — a person checks that it's actually usable before we hand it over.

footerCta.description: "Could AI do this?" — 60 minutes, free. No jargon.

about.heading: What it is
about.originLead: Not a demo or a trial — it's the final peak-limiting stage (a true-peak limiter) of the chain I always master with, pulled out and made free (its finished form, MUEDsp masterchain, is in development). It catches inter-sample peaks and holds true peaks to a ceiling you set (−1 dBTP by default).
about.controlsLead: INPUT for loudness, CEILING for the ceiling. That's all.

input.name: INPUT
input.desc: input drive, i.e. loudness (−6 to +18 dB).

ceiling.name: CEILING
ceiling.desc: the true-peak ceiling (−3 to 0 dBTP, default −1).

bypass.name: BYPASS
bypass.desc: a true bypass (ACTIVE / BYPASS), for honest A/B.

about.bypassNote: Plus a BYPASS toggle (ACTIVE / BYPASS), for honest A/B.

Below, a large amber INTEGRATED LUFS readout (−11.2) at the left, and SHORT-TERM −10.8, GR −0.6 dB, RANGE 6.7 LU and TRUE-PEAK −1.0 dBTP stacked at the right. A steady loudness-history graph around −11 with a dashed TARGET −14 line fills the center; a vertical true-peak meter showing green below its −1.0 dBTP ceiling on the right; and INPUT (+0.0 dB) and CEILING (−1.0 dBTP) knobs along the bottom.

hero.title: MUEDsat
hero.lead: Transformer color, taken straight out of the mastering chain I work with. Free.

about.heading: What it is
about.originLead: Not a demo or a trial — it's the transformer-saturation stage of the master chain I actually use, pulled out and made free (its finished form, MUEDsp masterchain, is in development). Push it for obvious grit, or back it off until it just sits under the sound.
about.intro1: MUEDsp saturation (aka MUEDsat) is the first of MUEDsp — a mastering plugin suite I'm building. Its finished form — MUEDsp masterchain — brings together the chain I always master with (I'm building it now). MUEDsat isn't a stripped-down demo or trial: it's an actual stage of that chain — the transformer saturation — pulled out as a standalone plugin and made free.
about.intro2: At its heart is one thing: transformer-style saturation. Turn it up for obvious grit, or back it off until it just sits under the sound.
about.bypassNote: Plus a true-dry bypass toggle, for honest A/B. Zero latency, no oversampling artifacts (ADAA).

drive.name: DRIVE
drive.desc: how hard you push the transformer (more = more harmonics).

air.name: Air
air.desc: a touch of clean high-shelf sheen.

mix.name: Mix
mix.desc: blend with the dry signal (parallel saturation).

bypass.name: Bypass
bypass.desc: A true dry passthrough, for honest A/B.

about.tech: Zero latency, and no oversampling artifacts (ADAA anti-aliasing). I like it on a master bus, a drum group, or anything that wants a little more body — but I'd rather you decide with your own ears than take my word for it.
